en: Map on tablet: the replay's "Tablet on this map" view can now show the map itself – circles, sliders and approach circles, synced with the replay, right where they were on your tablet area. Toggle and opacity next to the title; follows the Hidden switch.

Failed plays (osu!stable): new setting "Save failed plays automatically" – when your health runs out, osu!review presses F2 on the game over screen so the replay gets saved and analysed. Needs tosu running; off by default.

tosu built in: osu!review now downloads tosu once and runs it quietly in the background – pp from osu!lazer's calculator live and the failed-play detection work without installing anything. Already running your own tosu? Then that one is used. Can be turned off in Settings → pp.
Fixed: the window could freeze when a new score brought it to the front (same kind of problem as the grey window in beta.3).
